    summary

    Emmy Award-winning technical artist and creative technologist with 10+ years of Unreal Engine experience across real-time 3D, virtual production, motion capture, video games, broadcast, and AR graphics. Has led small teams of artists and developers, established pipelines, and show-ran live productions for clients including CBS Sports, CBS News, NBC, Netflix, and Disney. Actively mentoring and teaching emerging artists, developers, and technologists.

    experience

    Virtual Production Lead @ Astucemedia

    Jul 2026 – Present

    • Lead Unreal Engine and Pixotope virtual environment and AR graphics for CBS News’ 2026 Midterm Elections coverage, including election maps, race boards, seating charts, and data visualizations.
    • Integrate Unreal scenes into the Pixotope production workflow: rendering, compositing, scene management, broadcast output configuration, and camera tracking.
    • Validate performance, quality, and broadcast standards through testing and optimization; support rehearsals, readiness reviews, and live production.
    • Handle installation, integration, and production support at the client’s New York City facilities.

    Pipeline Technical Director @ Lucid

    Sep 2025 – May 2026

    • Created standards for multi-layered real-time content scenes using multiple Unreal Engine instances and SMPTE 2110 workflows.
    • Led QA and accelerated development of in-house open-source control software, working with a team of three.
    • Configured CI/CD pipelines using custom Python-assisted tools triggered by Perforce; set optimization and source control standards and trained new artists.
    • Integrated LLMs (primarily Claude) into the pipeline: AI agents for IT automation, Python scripting support, and experimental Unreal MCP tools that read Blueprints to generate documentation.

    Lead Unreal Technical Artist @ Disguise

    Jun 2022 – Sep 2025

    • Led a team of six artists and partnered with developers to deliver real-time virtual studios, virtual production sets, and broadcast graphics.
    • Project lead and creator of Nikon Studio Extreme at CES 2025: an AR booth (about 12,000 visitors) with real DMX lighting and a DMX-controlled fan, plus the participant teleprompter script.
    • Technical director on the Intuit Dome LA Clippers scoreboard, from research through on-site installation.
    • Delivered real-time graphics for NBC’s 2022 Midterm Elections coverage (about 10 million viewers), earning a News Emmy Award for technical excellence as a named recipient.
    • Supported TUDN’s Olympics coverage with virtual sets, remote Stype setup, and video I/O validation.
    • Built Unreal Engine automation and interactive systems on proprietary technologies, integrating REST APIs, WebSockets, OSC, SQL, and CMS databases; managed assets in Perforce and Git.
    • Researched and prototyped generative AI workflows, including Character AI for MetaHumans; provided client-facing on-site support, often live in a hot-seat.

    Virtual Production Technical Director @ Silver Spoon

    Oct 2019 – Jun 2022

    • Led graphics development for CBS Sports’ Super Bowl LV broadcast (96 million viewers across platforms) with a team of three, then served as on-site operator and installer in Tampa.
    • Technical director for 12+ CBS March Madness motion capture shoots on Vicon Shogun, with QA and previs in Unreal Engine and MotionBuilder; technical director on the live-preview mocap shoot for Joji’s “777” music video.
    • Built the AR workflow, DMX lighting control, and AR crowd controls for Netflix’s Iron Chef in Unreal Engine with Stype tracking; supervised on set and drove performance optimization.
    • Built AR and virtual production tools (broadcast graphics, film and episodic overlays, DMX integrations, and LED walls) with Stype and NCam tracking for live-overlay previs and VCam; operated live NFL and MLB broadcasts on-site.
    • Grew from specialist to client-facing senior/lead; trained staff and freelancers and mentored five interns, three of whom received full-time offers. Worked directly with Lucasfilm/ILM, Netflix, HBO, 343 Studios, EA, Framestore, Method Studios, The Rockwell Group, ESPN, and Fox Sports.
